transcripts.prompt: A bidder on the transformer RFQ asks if they can deliver all 24 units in two lots instead of three. What should I tell them?
transcripts.assistant_response:
**Tell them the published terms: delivery is 24 units in three lots of 8 to Central Stores.** Lot dates are set at award from each bidder's quoted lead time.

They can still offer a two-lot plan, but only as a variant bid under section 5.3 of the RFQ, submitted alongside a compliant three-lot bid. Because this answer is already in the published pack, you can send it without changing terms for other bidders.

The draft is ready for your review in the supplier portal. Nothing has been sent yet. RFQ-3301 closes 05 Nov 2026, in 6 days.

| 2 | Halden Transformer Works | $630,000 | 10 wks | Complete | 6/10 | **92.6** |
| 3 | Kelso Electrical Supply | $612,000 | 13 wks | Incomplete | 2/10 | **75.8** |

Weights are price 50, lead time 20, quality 20, sustainability 10.
